author: Leon_1998
quote: 0/10 — Dead Game, Alive Marketing.Dying Light mistakes repetition for content. Its story is forgettable, missions are glorified errands, combat feels clumsy, and weapon durability turns fun into maintenance. An open world wasted on fetch quests, artificial difficulty, and recycled zombie clichés. Parkour is its only saving grace—and even that can't rescue the exhausting gameplay loop. It makes surviving the apocalypse feel like doing unpaid overtime. Save your money.

author: Leon_1998
quote:
0/10 — Gaming's Most Expensive Disappointment.

13 years of development, billions in hype, and somehow the biggest achievement is making people forget what actual innovation looks like. A glorified tech demo wrapped in cinematic marketing, restrictive gameplay, and recycled ideas. Rockstar sells nostalgia as revolution, and gamers call it a masterpiece before even playing it. The hype is the real game; the product is just the DLC.

author: Leon_1998
quote:
0/10 — Hype Simulator.

13 years of waiting for a game that still locks you at 30 FPS, drags its opening, and occasionally confuses freedom with scripted missions. Beautiful world, questionable priorities. At this price, you're paying more for hype than innovation. Wait for a sale.

author: Leon_1998
quote: Leon Kennedy. Survival horror. Pure adrenaline. Absolute cinema. Resident Evil Requiem is a love letter to the franchise and a reminder of what video games are capable of. Capcom cooked. 10/10.
